name: Primary-Sample-Space Guiding with Kd-Trees
aliases: Kd-tree guided sampling of boundary segments
Kd-tree importance sampling for boundary segments
definition: A technique to efficiently sample boundary segments by mapping the problem to a 3D primary sample space (u1, u2) where u1 ∈ R and u2 ∈ R². The boundary integral is rewritten as a primary-sample-space integral.
